name: appointment-hero
title: Appointment hero
description: A clinic opening that reassures and offers the next free times as links, with a phone line for urgent cases.
docs: The title is an h1 by default, because a clinic's opening is the heading of its page; pass titleAs="h2" inside a page that has its own. Every slot is a plain link to your booking page for that exact time, so there is no half-finished flow in the hero. Leave slots empty and pass nextOpening to say when new times open.
